q: How do I calculate milk collection transport emissions per litre?
title: Milk collection route per litre
short: Add the diesel used by collection vehicles on village routes at 2.68 kg CO2 per litre and divide by litres of milk collected. Own vehicles are Scope 1; hired route contractors are Scope 3, Category 4. Report per route to find long, lightly loaded runs.
audience: Dairy cooperatives, chilling centres and milk unions

ul: Diesel for collection trucks and tankers.
Route distance and litres collected per route.
Chilling at bulk milk coolers, as a separate electricity line.

p: Vehicles the dairy owns and runs are Scope 1. Route contractors paid per trip or per litre are Scope 3, Category 4.
Divide by litres collected. Combine with chilling and plant figures for a farm-gate-to-plant transport and cooling number.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel invoices and fuel card statements (diesel 2.68 and CNG 2.69 kg CO2, IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 record. Hired transport goes to the Scope 3 evidence trail, and distance or tonne-km estimates are labelled as estimates.
